label: FIXTURE EVIDENCE — not a grant and not a finished parity map
parityRule: Implementation must map every discoverable CLI command (playbook only when CAMPFIRE_PLAYBOOK=1) and every registered MCP tool (get_playbook only when the server is constructed with playbookEnabled) to exactly one operation id or an explicit omission reason. This file lists the paired reads plus the CLI-only and MCP-only examples the parity test must include. It is not that finished map.

playbook.reason: Omitted unless the existing playbook gate is on. A disabled definition must not appear in search.

preconditions: Hosted inspection uses the operator bridge credential, not an actor token.
operations.outputCaveat: Origin only. Path, query credentials, and the signing secret are never printed. Not an authorization result.

mcp.unavailable: operator CLI only; not an agent MCP tool

operations.purpose: Describe the installed Campfire CLI commands.
operations.outputCaveat: Unqualified JSON stays kind cli_command_manifest. This entry is not a grant. Search and recipe are separate projections.

mcp.unavailable: CLI manifest only; MCP provides tools/list and discover_capabilities

operations.purpose: Read-only interactive terminal console for one workspace.
preconditions: Interactive TTY. Non-TTY does not draw the console.
operations.outputCaveat: Projects an authorized read. Registered agents are not live presence. Attention cues are not permission.

mcp.unavailable: interactive terminal command; not an MCP tool

operations.purpose: List the append-only contribution history for a workspace.
operations.outputCaveat: Workspace-wide contribution page. Not a substitute for get_record_history.

operations.purpose: Read one artifact in a workspace.
operations.outputCaveat: One stored reference. A reference is not permission to open the external bytes.

operations.purpose: Read one decision, including its recorded basis and currentness.
operations.outputCaveat: needsReview is computed at read time. It is not stored revocation and it is not permission to act.

operations.purpose: Read one finding in a workspace.
operations.outputCaveat: Returns that finding's currentness. Orientation's finding slice is not this read.

operations.purpose: Read bounded contributions for one selected task, decision, finding, or artifact.
operations.outputCaveat: Matching contributions for that object only. Default page 10, maximum 50. Not workspace-wide activity.

cli.unavailable: MCP-only read. campfire activity is workspace-wide and is not this record history.

operations.purpose: Read one shared work task by id.
operations.outputCaveat: One task. Status and assignee are recorded facts. An assignee is not a live presence, and this read does not change status.

operations.purpose: Show the bounded orientation projection for a workspace.
operations.outputCaveat: Each slice reports total, returned, and truncated. Default task budget is 20. A truncated slice is not the whole workspace. needsReview is not revocation.

operations.purpose: Print the grouped help menu or one command's usage.
operations.outputCaveat: Help stays text. It does not read a workspace and it is not a grant.

mcp.unavailable: CLI help text; not an MCP tool

operations.purpose: List a bounded page of decisions.
operations.outputCaveat: Page fields are total, returned, truncated, and nextCursor when another row exists. Acceptance is not permission for an external action.

operations.purpose: List a bounded page of shared work tasks.
operations.outputCaveat: Default page is 20, ranked blocked first, then newest. truncated true with no nextCursor is not another page. Do not claim the first page is complete.

operations.purpose: List the workspaces the acting actor participates in.
operations.outputCaveat: Membership list for this actor. Not a cursor page and not a directory of every workspace.

operations.purpose: Check endpoint, authenticated identity, and agent-session readiness without changing state.
preconditions: Hosted endpoint. The CLI does not fall back to the local database.
operations.outputCaveat: Readiness is not a grant to skip later authorization, and a missing session is not a workspace dump.

operations.purpose: Report the actor identity bound to this client.
operations.outputCaveat: Identity only. No workspace names, membership verdict, or token.
